title: Ple Ple Pleiades x Kagejitsu!
content:
I have no knowledge about Kagejitsu, but I sure enjoyed for Ainz and his goons. I mean, who doesn’t love a good spirited crossover episode?

By the looks of it, the other show must be another action fantasy, more oriented towards harem than strategy? I’m not complaining. I just love how clam and collected both of them were about this strange body swap, which makes me wonder if there is a similar Anime where a normal salary man or school boy would swap with a high fantasy peasant or lord. There is an interesting premise here and I would love to explore it.

The Ple Ple Pleiades art style really works well with these types of collabs, but I’m left feeling that this was the greatest one in terms of quality in Overlord’s shorts arsenal.

Overall: 7.14/10.
